text:
olivia: FYI customer (acct: ACME-2034) flagged their month-close invoice vs dashboard mismatch. Invoice shows 1.8M tokens, dashboard shows 1.2M. They say two extra line rows: one for 'pro' and one for 'enterprise' on same day. customer provided invoice_id=inv_00X and csv export.

matt: thx. can you paste invoice_id + customer org id and the dashboard snapshot link? also which cutoff timezone did they say? :thinking_face:

olivia: invoice_id=inv_00X, org=ACME-2034, dashboard snapshot link: https://console.redwood/usage/ACME-2034?range=month
customer says they were on a plan change during the day (pro->enterprise) at 23:58 local. believes tokens were double-counted across tiers.

anya: tagging finance. If there was a plan flip during cutoff we should see whether metering attribution window overlapped. can someone run a quick tokens-by-tier query for that account on the cutoff day? i want rows grouped by tier and ingestion_window.

ryan: possible race in the month-close rollup job that ran twice around midnight. i remember a bug where the backfill job didn't idempotent-check for in-flight metering batches. i'll run logs first.

invoices-bot: invoice inv_00X created for org ACME-2034 at 2076543305, total_tokens=1800012, lines=[{"tier":"pro","tokens":900006},{"tier":"enterprise","tokens":900006}]

matt: can you run this SQL and paste results?

olivia: running now. SQL:
```
SELECT tier, ingestion_window_start, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM metering.events
WHERE org_id='ACME-2034' AND event_time BETWEEN '2026-02-28 00:00:00' AND '2026-03-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY tier, ingestion_window_start
ORDER BY ingestion_window_start;
```

olivia: result (abbreviated):
```
pro | 2026-02-28 23:50:00 | 600003
enterprise | 2026-02-28 23:50:00 | 600003
pro | 2026-02-28 23:58:00 | 300003
enterprise | 2026-02-28 23:58:00 | 300003
```
This looks like duplicate rows at two ingestion_window_start points.

ryan: that matches the double-run theory. check job-run ids for metering-rollup at 23:50 and 23:58.

olivia: logs show:
```
[2026-02-28T23:50:12Z] metering-rollup job run id=rollup-1223 status=success
[2026-02-28T23:58:09Z] metering-rollup job run id=rollup-1224 status=success
```
both processed the same event batch because the ingestion producer retried with a new batch_id due to a transient SQS ack timeout.

anya: so tokens were processed twice and attributed to both tiers because the plan change occurred between the two runs. finance: will need to issue credit for duplicate tokens. what do we need to fix in prod to prevent recurrence?

matt: short-term: mark the duplicate ingestion_batch_ids and exclude them from invoice generation for this cycle. long-term: add idempotency check on metering-rollup where it dedupes by event_id / idempotency_key.

ryan: agreed. i'll create an SRE ticket to add dedupe and a check to make rollup idempotent. also add monitoring for >1 rollup run in 15m for same org.

olivia: customer wants repro steps and ETA for credit. can we commit to a timeline?

anya: finance will prepare a credit for duplicate tokens (approx 600k tokens). i'll get draft credit + note for the invoice within 48 hours once ops marks duplicates.

matt: action items:
- ryan: implement rollup dedupe guard + monitoring (P0 -> 3d for patch, 2w for full rollout)
- olivia: tell customer we've identified double-processing due to transient retry, we will issue credit within 48h and follow up when applied
- anya: prepare credit memo once duplicates are flagged
- billing-bot: block inv_00X from finalizing until duplicates are reconciled

invoices-bot: invoice inv_00X put into hold state by bot at 2076543600 pending manual review.

olivia: ok i'll reply to customer with a short note and ticket#SUP-8932. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:

matt: add postmortem tag and link once ryan opens the incident ticket. we should include the SQL and the log snippets above.

ryan: creating ticket INF-1129 and will start on the dedupe patch today. will post updates in this thread.

olivia: closing loop with customer text: "We found a duplicate rollup run that counted the same tokens twice during your plan change. We're issuing a credit for the extra tokens and will deploy a fix to prevent recurrence. Credit ETA: 48h. Ticket SUP-8932."
